data.title: Fake Tracking ID (FTID) Refund Fraud Indicators
data.description: Detects indicators of fake tracking ID (FTID) refund fraud, where a customer claims a package was not received or returned by providing a manipulated or fabricated tracking number. Indicators include tracking numbers that show delivery to the carrier facility but not to the customer address, tracking IDs associated with lightweight packages inconsistent with the order, or reuse of known FTID patterns across multiple refund claims.

detection.condition: selection and (filter_tracking_anomaly or filter_weight or filter_known_pattern)

falsepositives: Carrier mis-scan delivering to wrong address requiring legitimate reshipment
Lightweight promotional items or gift cards with valid low-weight tracking
